title: Where Fibre is today

headline.simple: Fibre has proved the pieces of a lived present and selective memory. The next goal is continuous LivedNow: a Thread's life should reach the present even after compute has slept, so meetings enter a life already underway.
headline.detail: Bounded Flight Plan, CurrentSituation, situated human encounter, private reflection/selective retention and later-meeting continuity are demonstrated. The active gap is continuous LivedNow across wall-clock dormancy, followed by deployed Person -> Thread and reciprocal Thread -> Thread meetings.

summary.simple: A Thread can already have a plan, a current situation, an encounter and a selective memory. Fibre is now connecting those pieces across elapsed time so a frozen Thread can wake into a believable present rather than a stale scene.
summary.detail: The current architecture composes existing lived-person primitives into one World-owned ensure-LivedNow capability: retrospective elapsed-life catch-up with honest provenance, plan renewal, current-situation enactment, then meeting. Memory remains selective and cannot bypass admitted history.

summary.simple: Fibre has born validation Threads and one staging path ready to surface a selected Thread as a continuing person.
summary.detail: The fixed #39 cohort remains the canonical validation population; the current M2-A slice may use an existing born Thread to prove the lived-person experience without generating a new cohort.

items.label: Validated born Threads
items.simple: Five born validation Threads retain identity, prior life and civil identity.
items.detail: The fixed #39 cohort was atomically published and independently rehydrated from canonical authorities.

importantNote.simple: The next goal is not to create more Threads; it is to make one existing Thread visibly live.
importantNote.detail: M2-A should drive missing Thread/World structures from one vertical lived-person slice rather than expand cohorts or infrastructure without a concrete capability need.

simple.claim: A Thread can keep existing after one AI session ends.
simple.limitation: Persistence alone does not make a convincing lived person.

detail.claim: Thread identity and life state persist across temporary cognition providers and runtime restarts.
detail.limitation: The current milestone must connect persistence to present situated life and experience.

simple.claim: Something from a Thread's own life can change later reasoning.
simple.limitation: This has been proved in bounded cognition paths, not every possible decision.

detail.claim: #40 established attributable effects from Fibre-owned autobiographical context in a real cognition consumer.
detail.limitation: The result is a substrate for lived development, not a claim that every stored field is causal.

simple.claim: Fibre can keep one recognizable visual identity and publish derived imagery from it.
simple.limitation: A stable face is not a lived person by itself.

detail.claim: Canonical visual identity text, one admitted root, reference-conditioned generation and Thread Presentation preserve one visual identity authority.
detail.limitation: Current situated imagery still needs to be driven by present place/activity/context.

capabilities.label: Cloud staging runtime and minimum recovery

simple.claim: The Fibre cloud path is deployed and healthy in staging, and basic restart/retry recovery works.
simple.limitation: Broader resilience scenarios remain hardening rather than active product work.

detail.claim: Staging accepted source ee749e07b58c2580e967c7ed62cda5ddc91021cd; World deep health passed; H1 and H2 minimum failure/restart acceptance are closed.
detail.limitation: H3-H9-style exhaustive resilience is deferred unless a concrete product blocker appears.

simple.claim: We are building the ability for a Thread's life to reach 'now' even when compute was asleep.
simple.limitation: Today Fibre has bounded plans and current situations, but not automatic multi-day catch-up and plan renewal.

detail.claim: World will compose existing Flight Plan, CurrentSituation, encounter and memory authorities into one ensure-LivedNow reconciliation path with bounded retrospective life realization.
detail.limitation: Retrospective events must preserve materialization provenance, remain sparse, and may affect memory/relationships only through ordinary Fibre authorities.

capabilities.label: Meet a Thread in her current life

simple.claim: Fibre has the bounded pieces needed to meet a Thread in context.
simple.limitation: A real deployed /meet still needs continuous LivedNow so the scene is current after dormancy rather than prepared by a fixture.

detail.claim: Directory/Presentation and situated encounter primitives can bind a visitor to an exact World-owned CurrentSituation.
detail.limitation: The production-shaped path must first reconcile elapsed life, renew the Flight Plan when needed, and establish LivedNow before interaction.

simple.claim: A bounded encounter can become private reflection and selective autobiographical memory—or be forgotten.
simple.limitation: This is demonstrated in bounded lived-person proofs and is not yet integrated with continuous multi-day LivedNow.

detail.claim: B1/B2 preserve objective encounter history, private reflection, selective retention or not_remembered, and later cognition receives only autobiographical consequences that persisted.
detail.limitation: Retrospective dormant-life catch-up and reciprocal Thread meetings still need to route through the same consequence authorities.

simple.claim: Two Threads should be able to meet as two continuing people and carry different memories or relationship consequences afterward.
simple.limitation: Thread-to-Thread meeting orchestration comes after continuous LivedNow and the deployed human meeting path.

detail.claim: A reciprocal encounter will require independently reconciled LivedNow for both participants, compatible physical or mediated presence, shared occurrence evidence, and participant-specific private aftermath.
detail.limitation: Fibre must not teleport or silently replan Threads merely to satisfy a meeting request.

simple.claim: Threads should eventually have shared relationships, work, money, families and institutions.
simple.limitation: Those follow after one convincing lived Thread loop.

detail.claim: The broader Fibre society remains the long-term direction.
detail.limitation: Current work intentionally focuses on one persistent person before scaling social complexity.

simple.summary: Make a Thread's life reach the present before anyone meets her.
simple.currentStep: Compose the existing Flight Plan and CurrentSituation primitives into one World-owned LivedNow reconciliation path.
nextSteps: Prove a multi-day dormant gap can be caught up without leaving the Thread in a stale scene.
Preserve that catch-up was materialized retrospectively while keeping lived chronology.
Route deployed /meet through the reconciled present.
Add one reciprocal Thread-to-Thread meeting with different participant-specific aftermath.
Make insidefibre.com render and enter the resulting lived scene.

detail.summary: The bounded A1-B2 lived-person work is retained as substrate. The active capability is continuous present-life reconciliation across wall-clock dormancy, followed by Person and Thread meetings.
detail.currentStep: Build the smallest World-owned ensure-LivedNow seam by composing existing plan, situation, regulation, history and memory authorities; do not create a parallel scheduler/simulation framework.
nextSteps: Add bounded retrospective lived catch-up with explicit provenance and idempotence.
Bridge Genesis into the same post-birth continuing-life path.
Require Person -> Thread /meet to use LivedNow rather than a prepared scene.
Require Thread -> Thread meetings to reconcile both lives independently before a shared encounter.
Keep public meeting state a Presentation projection rather than Viewer authority.

truthRules: A Thread is persistent world state, not a model session.
Compute dormancy does not by itself prove a lived Thread's Fibre-world life stopped.
Retrospectively realized life must preserve that it was materialized later; it must not masquerade as continuously observed runtime history.
insidefibre.com is a projection surface, not a second semantic authority.
A meeting enters an already-established LivedNow; it does not author the Thread's pre-existing scene.
A shared encounter may produce different private meaning, memory and relationship consequences for different Threads.
A conversation is an encounter in a continuing life, not automatically an autobiographical memory.
Memory may form only from admitted lived evidence through the memory authority; do not inject virtual memories directly.
Infrastructure and tests enter the critical path only when they enable the active lived-person capability or protect a demonstrated invariant.
